mapper.sql: SELECT x.material_id, SUM(x.min_qty) AS min_qty, SUM(x.max_qty) AS max_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN x.qty < x.min_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_count, SUM(CASE WHEN x.qty > x.max_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_count FROM (SELECT wl.material_id, wl.warehouse_id, wl.min_qty, wl.max_qty, COALESCE(SUM(ws.qty), 0) AS qty FROM wms_material_warehouse_limit wl JOIN wms_material wm ON wm.id = wl.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock ws ON ws.material_id = wl.material_id AND ws.warehouse_id = wl.warehouse_id WHERE wm.alert_mode = 'WAREHOUSE' AND wl.warehouse_id = #{${wh}} GROUP BY wl.material_id, wl.warehouse_id, wl.min_qty, wl.max_qty) x GROUP BY x.material_id

SELECT am.id AS material_id, am.alert_mode, CASE WHEN am.alert_mode = 'WAREHOUSE' THEN wa.min_qty ELSE am.safety_stock END AS min_qty, CASE WHEN am.alert_mode = 'WAREHOUSE' THEN wa.max_qty ELSE am.max_stock END AS max_qty, CASE WHEN am.alert_mode = 'WAREHOUSE' THEN CASE WHEN wa.low_count > 0 THEN 'LOW' WHEN wa.high_count > 0 THEN 'HIGH' END WHEN COALESCE(tq.qty, 0) < am.safety_stock THEN 'LOW' WHEN COALESCE(tq.qty, 0) > am.max_stock THEN 'HIGH' END AS alert, COALESCE(wa.low_count, 0) AS low_count, COALESCE(wa.high_count, 0) AS high_count FROM wms_material am LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_id, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock GROUP BY material_id) tq ON tq.material_id = am.id LEFT JOIN () wa ON wa.material_id = am.id WHERE am.safety_stock IS NOT NULL OR am.max_stock IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT wl.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS qty, wl.min_qty, wl.max_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) < wl.min_qty THEN 'LOW' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) > wl.max_qty THEN 'HIGH' END AS alert FROM wms_material_warehouse_limit wl JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = wl.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock s ON s.material_id = wl.material_id AND s.warehouse_id = wl.warehouse_id WHERE wl.material_id = #{materialId} GROUP BY wl.warehouse_id, w.name, w.sort, wl.min_qty, wl.max_qty ORDER BY w.sort, wl.warehouse_id
mapper.insert:
